params.name: limit
params.description: Page size (number of questionnaires per page).

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of rows to skip before the first returned questionnaire.

items.docs: List your questionnaires, newest first, in a limit/offset pagination envelope (`{count, next, previous, results}`, default page size 50). Each row is one version; `questionnaire_group_id` is the stable group ID resolved to the latest `published` version.
Create a simple linear questionnaire. Send `form_elements` in display order; branching and repeatable groups require the Console. Defaults to `published` v1.

params.name: questionnaire_uuid
params.description: Per-version UUID of the questionnaire (the `uuid` value returned by the list endpoint, also returned as `questionnaire_id` on detail endpoints).

items.docs: Fetch full questionnaire detail for one version by `questionnaire_uuid`: title, `languages`, canonical `graph`, derived `sections`, and version metadata.

params.name: questionnaire_uuid
params.description: Per-version UUID of the questionnaire to update.

items.docs: Update a questionnaire. params.name: questionnaire_uuid
params.description: Per-version UUID of the questionnaire to delete.

items.docs: Permanently delete one questionnaire version (hard delete, no undo). Stored questionnaire responses linked to this version are deleted with it, and sessions referencing it lose the link; other versions in the same group are not deleted. Workflows that referenced it keep running but the questionnaire step can no longer load it.
